questions: What is the deadline to file an appeal?
How many working days do I have to appeal?
How long do I have to appeal?
entries.claim: Five working days from service of the order for the written appeal described in clause i.
entries.context: Written disciplinary appeal by the student awarded the penalty to the Vice-Chancellor. Time runs from service of the order.
entries.exceptions: Pending independent review of governing provisions and exceptions.

witnesses.quotation:
A student having been awarded a penalty for any act(s) of indiscipline or misconduct shall have

the right to file an appeal (in writing) for review of the decision to the Vice-Chancellor within

5 working days of the service of the order.

entries.claim: Review authority for major penalties under clause ii.
entries.context: Appeal clause ii. Distinguish review from imposition.
entries.exceptions: Pending independent review of governing provisions and exceptions.

witnesses.quotation: The powers to review the major penalties imposed shall lie with the Vice-Chancellor.

entries.claim: Review authority for minor penalties under clause ii.
entries.context: Appeal clause ii. Distinguish review from imposition.
entries.exceptions: Pending independent review of governing provisions and exceptions.

witnesses.quotation:
Powers

to review the minor penalties shall be with Chief Proctor / School Dean on one level above

principle.

questions: Is rustication a possible disciplinary punishment?
entries.claim: Rustication is listed as a possible punishment under Category I.
entries.context: Category I list. This question concerns possibility only. Category II separately lists rustication on page 9. No individual offence mapping.
entries.exceptions: Pending independent review of governing provisions and exceptions.

witnesses.quotation:
The competent authority may impose any of the following punishments on any student found

guilty of any of the acts of indiscipline or misconduct mentioned in Category I or Category II,

as the case may be in Rule 3.

2. Rustication up to 2-4 semesters period and/or declaring any part or the entire University

Campus out of bounds.

questions: Does making a complaint to a committee member debar that member from sitting?
entries.claim: A complaint to a member does not itself debar that member from sitting.
entries.context: Only addresses committee membership following a complaint. Not a student debarment rule.
entries.exceptions: Pending independent review of governing provisions and exceptions.

witnesses.quotation:
(However, a student making a complaint to a

member of the Proctorial Committee / Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) / ARC, etc. will

not debar such member from sitting as a member.)

questions: Is gambling on University premises listed as misconduct?
Can I gamble on university premises?
entries.claim: The list includes gambling on University premises.
entries.context: Section 7 Category II item 9. The list does not establish a specific penalty.
entries.exceptions: Pending independent review of governing provisions and exceptions.

witnesses.quotation: 9. Indulging in acts of gambling in the University premises.
